target.title: fix: stop model catalog warning loop during sidecar refresh
target.body:
Closes #99390

AI-assisted: yes.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where gateway model-catalog refreshes could race read-only catalog scans while generated plugin model catalog sidecars were being rewritten. In affected setups this could surface as a repeating `[model-catalog] Failed to load model catalog: FsSafeError: directory changed during operation` warning loop and leave dynamic provider catalog rows stale or unavailable.

## Why This Change Was Made

The fix reuses the existing process-wide keyed queue for model catalog file IO, but changes the key from the root `models.json` file to the agent catalog file set. Generated plugin sidecar writes and read-only persisted catalog scans for the same agent directory now share one narrow serialization point, without changing provider catalog schema, runtime config, or plugin-facing behavior.

## User Impact

Users and operators should no longer see read-only model catalog calls race generated plugin catalog sidecar refreshes for the same agent profile. Dynamic provider discovery can publish sidecar catalog updates without the read path observing the sidecar tree mid-write.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/models-config.write-serialization.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/model-catalog.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/models-config.write-serialization.test.ts src/agents/model-catalog.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/model-catalog.test.ts src/agents/models-config.write-serialization.test.ts src/gateway/server-model-catalog.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods/models.test.ts`
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/agents/models-config-state.ts src/agents/models-config.ts src/agents/model-catalog.ts src/agents/models-config.write-serialization.test.ts`
- `node_modules/.bin/oxlint --threads=1 src/agents/models-config-state.ts src/agents/models-config.ts src/agents/model-catalog.ts src/agents/models-config.write-serialization.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.test.src.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/test-src.tsbuildinfo`
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo`
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base origin/main` reported no accepted/actionable findings.

Proof gap: I did not run a live authenticated Anthropic/systemd gateway reproduction. The regression test covers the overlapping generated plugin catalog sidecar write plus read-only scan interleaving that caused the reported warning loop.
